blocks.heading: How to Use e-Services
blocks.lead: Steps for submitting online service requests to the Office of the Royal Society

items.title: Choose a service
items.body: Choose the service you need on the e-Services page

items.title: Read the regulations
items.body: Read the regulations and conditions of the service in full

items.title: Download and complete the form
items.body: Download the request form, fill it in and prepare supporting documents

items.title: Submit documents
items.body: Email the form and supporting documents to saraban@orst.go.th (.pdf .doc .docx files, up to 10MB)
